messages.subject: grob names into grobs?
parts:
Hello ggplot2'ers,

I have a number of graphic objects (grobs) that I created with ggplot2 and have prefixed their names with "g_".

e.g. g_x_and_y_by_zcat
> class( g_x_and_y_by_zcat )
[1] "ggplot"

> graphs <- grep("^g_", ls(), value=TRUE )
> class(graphs)
[1] "character"

Essentially, I am trying to write a function that will parse out elements in the name of a grob, create a relevant PNG filename, and then print the grob to the pngfile. The goal is that I'd also like this to operate on all the graphs in my "graphs" object which contains all my grob names, hopefully using the Plyr library ( perhaps l_ply I think...), such that the output will be PNG files containing the graphs

I imagine the function will be something like:

draw_graph <- function( grobname ) {
png_fn = paste( grobname, ".png", sep="")
print( png_fn )
png( filename=png_fn )
print( grobname )
dev.off()
}

...followed by the use of l_ply.

This doesn't quite work however, because the print(grobname) is evaluating as a name rather than as the gglot2 object that I would like it to be. I have been playing with do.call() with as.list(graphs) to try to coerce this to evaluate, but so far without success.

Is there a way to do this?

Any help appreciated.

Thanks,
Avram
